movelist.name: Mega Drain
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Razor Leaf
movelist.effect: Razor Leaf is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Growth
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage. If it is Sunny, double the amount of Combat Stages gained.

movelist.name: Gust
movelist.effect: If the target is airborne as a result of Fly or Sky Drop, Gust can hit them, ignoring Range and has a Damage Base of 8 instead.

movelist.name: Cotton Spore
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Speed lowered 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.effect: The user gains a +2 Bonus to Stealth Checks, does not trigger Hazards, Blessings cannot be activated in response to its actions, and the user may bypass the effects of the move Substitute.

abilities.name: Chlorophyll
abilities.effect: While in Sunny Weather or under 50% Max Hit Points, the user’s Initiative is doubled.
